nodes.label: Statement 12: Options for Antipsychotic-Associated Parkinsonism
nodes.rationale: Rigidity, tremor, and bradykinesia impair quality of life and adherence; dose reduction, switching, or anticholinergic treatment benefits likely outweigh psychosis-relapse and anticholinergic risks.

nodes.label: Medication-Induced Parkinsonism Managed by Dose, Switch, or Anticholinergic
nodes.rationale: Use lowest effective anticholinergic dose for shortest duration; withdraw after weeks to months when possible; monitor cognition, falls, urinary, and thermoregulatory harms.

nodes.label: Amantadine as Non-Anticholinergic Alternative for Parkinsonism
nodes.rationale: Weak NMDA antagonist with comparable or slightly less benefit than anticholinergics but fewer cognitive effects; preferred when anticholinergic burden must be avoided.
